perks.name: Special Relativity
perks.description: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
perks.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Refills stowed Special Weapons.

perks.name: Superluminal Motion
perks.description: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
perks.exact:
Upon dealing Super Damage, while Movement Speed isn't 0m/s:
Restores 2? [?] HP/s for 11 seconds. 
Dealing Additional Super Damage refreshes the buff duration.
